description: Source file implementing linked list operations for pattern nodes, including insertion, search, comparison, printing, and cleanup, with external dependencies on GLib and custom logging utilities.

methods.name: insertPCNode
methods.description: Inserts a new pattern node at the beginning of the list, allocating memory and copying input data.

methods.name: comparePattern
methods.description: Performs custom comparison between a node pattern and a search pattern, returning 0 if the pattern is found within the search string.

methods.name: searchPCNode
methods.description: Searches for a pattern node in the list matching the given pattern.

methods.name: print_pc_node
methods.description: Debug function to print details of a pattern node.

methods.name: printPCNodes
methods.description: Prints all pattern nodes in the list.

methods.name: freePCNode
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a pattern node.

methods.name: clearPCNodes
methods.description: Clears and frees all nodes in the list.
